summary: Three-component vector copy (__thiscall): when source a2 is non-null, copies three consecutive dwords from a2 into the destination struct at byte offsets 0x18, 0x1C and 0x20 (elements [6],[7],[8] of the dword view of this). Returns the third source dword a2[2], or a2 itself when the source is null. Matches the Vector_Copy ABI shape.

operations.description: Guard on a2: when the source pointer is null the copy is skipped and a2 is returned as-is.
Copy source dword 0 into destination byte offset 0x18 (this + 6).
Copy source dword 1 into destination byte offset 0x1C (v3[1]).
Copy source dword 2 into destination byte offset 0x20 (v3[2]) and keep it as the return value.
Return the third copied dword a2[2] (as a pointer-sized value), or a2 when the source was null.

Invoked by sub_457000 (0x00457000), sub_4572B0 (0x004572B0), CollisionResponseWithRandomPerturbation (0x00457A00), StateActivatedPositionSaveRestore (0x00457B00), F_2DTransformStructCopy (0x00457B60), sub_4585E0 (0x004585E0), sub_458DF0 (0x00458DF0), ComponentTransformInitializer (0x00459010) and sub_459330 (0x00459330) to populate a three-component transform/position field.

unresolved: Whether the copied triple at +0x18 is position, velocity or another 3D quantity depends on the owning struct, which is unknown here
